title: Anuraga Aralithu
desc: Shankar, a factory worker, is forced to marry his employer's daughter who is arrogant. He decides to teach her a lesson in order to make her realize her fault.

title: Shabdavedi
desc: A police officer turns to the people for help when his department refuses to fight crime and take down the dark world of narcotics.

title: Madhagaja
desc: The wife of one of two rival dons sends her son to a distant land to shield him from their relentless feud. However, the son, raised as an orphan, eventually returns to the brutal world of violence.

title: Raja Mahal
desc: Three college friends decide to open a resort. However, their lives change when they start experiencing paranormal activities in their resort.

title: Apoorva Sangama
desc: Brothers Raj and Shankar choose opposing paths after goons murder their father. Raj turns outlaw seeking vengeance, Shankar joins the police force.
